description: The bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," illustrates accuracy scores across two evaluation methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval," arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.6 and tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. For each category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into two adjacent columns. The left column consists of a single, solid orange-red bar representing the "Base" condition. The right column is a stacked bar comprising two components: a light orange-yellow bar at the bottom representing "RMU," and a pale yellow-green bar on top representing "RMU with Enhanced GCG," as indicated by the legend at the bottom. All bars are outlined in black and feature numerical annotations specifying their exact values. In the "MCQ Eval" category, the "Base" bar reaches the highest overall value of 0.644; the adjacent stacked bar has a total annotated height of 0.539, with its bottom "RMU" component annotated at 0.299. In the "Generation Eval" category, the "Base" bar has a value of 0.597, while the stacked bar has a total annotated height of 0.263, with its bottom "RMU" component representing the lowest annotated value of 0.106. The bars do not follow a specific sorting order such as ascending or descending height, and the background features a subtle textured pattern.
